observation.visible_scene: A person wearing a brown hooded top and an orange life vest sits inside a low raft/cage built from a tangle of dark tubes and pipe-noodles, floating in churning green whitewater. A single paddle with a yellow blade and blue shaft is held in the raft. The background shows a concrete spillway channel with angled walls and several blue floating barrier pontoons. Throughout the excerpt the raft stays roughly mid-frame, bobbing and being washed by the rapids.
visible_changes: The paddle blade starts near-vertical (pointing up, tilted slightly right) in the early frames, then progressively leans to the right, becoming nearly horizontal across the tube pile by the mid frames, and finally dipping below the water surface and disappearing from view in the last frames.

The person's head and torso, initially upright and clearly visible above the tubes, gradually lower: by the mid frames the body is reclined inside the raft, and by the final frames the person is largely hidden behind/below the tube structure and splashing water.
The raft sits progressively lower in the water, with increasing whitewater washing over the tubes toward the end of the clip.
The tube raft rotates and shifts slightly within the current; the loop of tubes on the right side remains the most persistent visible feature of the structure.
The camera framing is largely stable on the raft with only minor drift; the concrete walls and blue pontoons remain in the background throughout.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the person came to be in the raft and whether the sinking/lying-down is intentional or the result of an unseen event.
Whether the paddle is dropped, submerged, or recovered after the clip ends.
Whether the person resurfaces or the raft capsizes fully after the final frame.
uncertain_details: The person's state (awake and lying down vs. incapacitated) cannot be determined from the images.
Exact camera motion (fixed vs. slight pan/zoom following the raft) is hard to confirm because the background shifts only subtly.
The precise material of the tubes and the paddle is not identifiable beyond visual appearance.
